{{Top|leg}}
'''Vision enhancement devices''' were built into the [[Iskalonian rebreather garb|special rebreathers]] worn by the [[Chuhkyvi]] [[Species/Legends|species]] if they wanted to survive outside of [[Water/Legends|water]] for more than an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. An aquatic species, Chuhkyvi had poor [[Eye/Legends|eyesight]] when out of water, necessitating the use of the vision enhancement devices to compensate.<ref name="Marvel">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
